provenance.asset_description: Yivali Working, artist Ivan Koritarev : An image of the nosoi Yivali, a psychopomp that resembles a raven wearing a white mask. Yivali is in a library writing notes on a scroll with a quill. Other nosois fly around, cataloging scrolls and tomes.
